nearest_text_before.text: В парке также недавно появилось новое иммерсивное шоу «По ту сторону цирка»(да-да, тот самый огромный клоун). Вход оплачивается отдельно, но поверьте, оно стоит того. Вас ждет ужасно веселое путешествие по 19 зловещим помещениям старого цирка в компании 20 артистов.

nearest_text_after.text: Завершить любой из маршрутов советую «Воздушным экспрессом». Это обзорная поездка под куполом на высоте 9 метров с живописными видами. В лучах закатного солнца особенно красиво!

image_reading: A whimsical indoor amusement-park scene under a glass dome, dominated by a lit golden castle, an elevated curved rail track, and a small ornate ride vehicle.
Visible moving elements include the elevated vehicle, suspended swing seats, and guests; hot-air-balloon decorations and bright theatrical façades reinforce a fantasy atmosphere.
analysis.article_context: Body image illustrating the park's elaborate photo-worthy themed décor; it appears after the visit-route advice and before the recommendation to finish with the elevated Air Express ride under the dome.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: A visit to the park is an immersive journey through striking themed scenery and memorable attractions.
structured_intent.primary_action: The elevated ride vehicle travels continuously along its curved track toward the castle.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The ride vehicle is visibly farther around the curved track, still approaching the castle.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The location remains a bright, welcoming fantasy park whose décor invites visitors to look around and take photos.

models.scene_plan: Across five seconds, the central ride vehicle begins moving immediately and makes a smooth, moderate advance along the visible curve toward the castle. The suspended seats retain a subtle natural sway as secondary motion. Keep a fixed wide camera so the vehicle, track, castle, and dome remain readable; reach a clearly advanced position on the curve in the final moments.
models.positive_prompt: The ornate elevated ride vehicle glides steadily along the curved track toward the golden castle while the swing ride gently turns overhead. Fixed wide view; in the final frame the vehicle is clearly farther around the curve, with the fantasy park still lively.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, use the track ride as the continuous action: it rolls at an even pace from its current central position deeper around the curve toward the castle. Maintain a stable broad composition to showcase the scenery and route; let only the already-visible overhead ride move gently in support. End near the close of the shot with the vehicle noticeably farther along the rails.
models.positive_prompt: The small elevated train travels smoothly around the foreground curve toward the castle, with a light sway in the hanging ride seats above. Fixed wide framing; by the last frame the train has progressed visibly along the track and the park retains its festive fantasy atmosphere.

models.scene_plan: Over four seconds, make the ornate vehicle travel continuously and briskly but smoothly along the foreground curve in the direction of the castle. Use a fixed wide view to keep the immersive decorative setting legible. The hanging seats show faint ambient motion only; finish with the vehicle in a clearly new, forward position on the track.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed wide shot: the elevated ride vehicle smoothly rounds the curved track toward the golden castle as the hanging seats gently sway. At the end, the vehicle is visibly farther along the curve, preserving the bright, inviting fantasy-park atmosphere.
